content.title: Detailing Bros
content.intro: Detailing Bros delivers showroom‑shine results with meticulous interior cleaning, paint protection, and custom detailing packages for any vehicle.

sections.title: Exterior Services
sections.body: Hand wash, paint correction, ceramic coating, and wheel restoration to protect and enhance your car’s finish.

sections.title: Interior Services
sections.body: Deep vacuum, steam cleaning, leather conditioning, and odor elimination for a fresh, spotless cabin.

sections.title: Custom Packages
sections.body: Tailored bundles combine exterior and interior work, plus add‑ons like headlight restoration and engine bay detailing.
